unitNote: A search-hour is wall-clock time inside a Pro search. The meter has no venue dimension: local and cloud execution burn the SAME hours. Local-first improves our margin, not the customer's bill — never state or imply a customer saves hours by running locally.
sourceOfTruth: packages/bluehelm/src/bluehelm/config.py in mobluehq-llc/mobluehq-platform (fields entry_search_hours / starter_search_hours / paid_search_hours / topup_search_hours). This file's numbers must match that config; run `node scripts/check_pricing_sync.mjs` to verify, and re-run it any time the config or this file changes.
